spans.text: At one time the Buddha was staying near Kosambī in Ghosita’s monastery.

entries.description: Then Anuruddha went to Nandiya and Kimbila
entries.subject: Then Anuruddha

spans.text: Atha kho āyasmā anuruddho yenāyasmā ca nandiyo yenāyasmā ca kimilo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantañca nandiyaṁ āyasmantañca kimilaṁ etadavoca: Then Anuruddha went to Nandiya and Kimbila, and said to them, “Khamanīyaṁ bhagavā, yāpanīyaṁ bhagavā, na ca mayaṁ, bhante, piṇḍakena kilamāmā”ti.

entries.description: and said to them
entries.subject: and

spans.text: Atha kho āyasmā anuruddho yenāyasmā ca nandiyo yenāyasmā ca kimilo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantañca nandiyaṁ āyasmantañca kimilaṁ etadavoca: Then Anuruddha went to Nandiya and Kimbila, and said to them, “Khamanīyaṁ bhagavā, yāpanīyaṁ bhagavā, na ca mayaṁ, bhante, piṇḍakena kilamāmā”ti.

spans.text: Atha kho āyasmā ca anuruddho āyasmā ca nandiyo āyasmā ca kimilo bhagavantaṁ paccuggantvā Then Anuruddha, Nandiya, and Kimbila came out to greet the Buddha.

entries.description: his bowl and robe
entries.subject: his bowl

spans.text: One received his bowl and robe, one spread out a seat, and one set out water for washing his feet.

entries.task_id: venerables bowed|and|sat down to one side
entries.description: venerables bowed and sat down to one side
entries.subject: venerables bowed

spans.text: Those venerables bowed and sat down to one side.

entries.description: The Buddha said to Anuruddha
entries.subject: The Buddha

spans.text: Ekamantaṁ nisinnaṁ kho āyasmantaṁ anuruddhaṁ bhagavā etadavoca: The Buddha said to Anuruddha, “kacci vo, anuruddhā, khamanīyaṁ, kacci yāpanīyaṁ, kacci piṇḍakena na kilamathā”ti?

entries.description: Anuruddha and friends
entries.subject: Anuruddha

spans.text: “I hope you’re keeping well, Anuruddha and friends, I hope you’re all right.
“Good, good, Anuruddha and friends!
“Good, good, Anuruddha and friends!

entries.description: like milk and water
entries.subject: like milk

spans.text: “I hope you’re living in harmony, appreciating each other, without quarreling, blending like milk and water, and regarding each other with kindly eyes?”
“That’s how we live in harmony, appreciating each other, without dispute, blending like milk and water, and regarding each other with kindly eyes.”

entries.description: venerables Nandiya and Kimbila spoke likewise
entries.subject: venerables Nandiya

spans.text: And the venerables Nandiya and Kimbila spoke likewise, and they added: āyasmāpi kho kimilo bhagavantaṁ etadavoca: “mayhampi kho, bhante, evaṁ hoti: ‘lābhā vata me, suladdhaṁ vata me yohaṁ evarūpehi sabrahmacārīhi saddhiṁ viharāmī’ti.

entries.description: in public and in private
entries.subject: in public

spans.text: Tassa mayhaṁ, bhante, imesu āyasmantesu mettaṁ kāyakammaṁ paccupaṭṭhitaṁ āvi ceva raho ca, I consistently treat these venerables with kindness by way of body, speech, and mind, both in public and in private.

entries.task_id: own ideas|and|just go along with these venerables’ ideas?’

entries.subject: own ideas
entries.object: just go along with these venerables’ ideas?’

spans.text: ‘Why don’t I set aside my own ideas and just go along with these venerables’ ideas?’

entries.description: drinking water and the rubbish bin
entries.subject: drinking water

spans.text: “In this case, sir, whoever returns first from almsround prepares the seats, and puts out the drinking water and the rubbish bin.

entries.description: it if they like
entries.subject: it if

spans.text: Yo pacchā gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamati—sace hoti bhuttāvaseso, sace ākaṅkhati, bhuñjati; no ce ākaṅkhati, appaharite vā chaḍḍeti apāṇake vā udake opilāpeti— If there’s remainder, whoever returns last eats it if they like.

entries.task_id: otherwise|they|throw it out where there is little that grows
entries.description: Otherwise they throw it out where there is little that grows
entries.subject: Otherwise
entries.object: throw it out where there is little that grows

spans.text: Otherwise they throw it out where there is little that grows, or drop it into water that has no living creatures.

entries.description: Then they put away the seats
entries.subject: Then

spans.text: Then they put away the seats, drinking water, and rubbish bin, and sweep the refectory.

entries.description: is empty they set it up
entries.subject: is empty

spans.text: If someone sees that the pot of water for washing, drinking, or the toilet is empty they set it up.

entries.task_id: and|they|set it up by lending each other a hand to lift
entries.description: and they set it up by lending each other a hand to lift
entries.subject: and
entries.object: set it up by lending each other a hand to lift

spans.text: If he can’t do it, he summons another with a wave of the hand, and they set it up by lending each other a hand to lift.

entries.description: whole night and discuss the teachings
entries.subject: whole night

spans.text: And every five days we sit together for the whole night and discuss the teachings.

entries.task_id: in knowledge|and|vision worthy of the noble ones
entries.description: in knowledge and vision worthy of the noble ones
entries.subject: in knowledge
entries.object: vision worthy of the noble ones

spans.text: But as you live diligently like this, have you achieved any superhuman distinction in knowledge and vision worthy of the noble ones, a comfortable meditation?”

entries.description: both light and vision of forms
entries.subject: both light

spans.text: “Well, sir, while meditating diligent, keen, and resolute, we perceive both light and vision of forms.
So kho pana no obhāso nacirasseva antaradhāyati dassanañca rūpānaṁ; But before long the light and the vision of forms vanish.
But before long my light and vision of forms vanished.

entries.task_id: when i|was|still unawakened but intent on awakening—i too perceived light and vision of forms

spans.text: Before my awakening—when I was still unawakened but intent on awakening—I too perceived light and vision of forms.
